sections.title: SYNOPSIS
sections.text: MB/ND SHORTWAVE TROUGH EXPECTED TO CONTINUE ESE INTO CNTRL ONT/MN...WITH SOME AMPLIFICATION LIKELY AS JET STREAK NOW OVER CNTRL MT SWEEPS ESE TO THE MN/IA BORDER. AT THE SAME TIME...LEAD SHORTWAVE IMPULSE SHOULD CONTINUE E ACROSS QUE AS UPR HIGHS REMAIN STNRY OVER THE CNTRL APPALACHIANS AND SRN RCKYS. FARTHER S...HYBRID T.S. LEE EXPECTED TO EDGE ONLY VERY SLOWLY N THROUGH THE PERIOD...REACHING S CNTRL LA BY 12Z SUN. AT THE SFC...COLD FRONT ATTENDANT TO MB/ND TROUGH SHOULD ADVANCE STEADILY E ACROSS THE MID/UPR MS VLYS AND UPR GRT LKS...AND S/SE ACROSS THE PLNS. AHEAD OF THIS FRONT...WRN END OF FRONT ASSOCIATED WITH QUE IMPULSE WILL DRIFT SLOWLY N AS A DIFFUSE WARM FRONT ACROSS NRN IL/SRN LWR MI. THE ERN PART OF THE SAME BOUNDARY...MEANWHILE...SHOULD SETTLE SLOWLY SE AS A COLD FRONT ACROSS NRN NEW ENGLAND.

sections.title: LWR MO VLY TO UPR GRT LKS TODAY/TNGT
sections.text: SMALL FORWARD-PROPAGATING MCS NOW IN WRN LWR MI EXPECTED TO CONTINUE ENE ACROSS THE REMAINDER OF LWR MI LATER THIS MORNING. SYSTEM IS SLIGHTLY ELEVATED AND LIKELY IS BEING SUPPORTED BY CONFLUENCE ALONG NARROW...COLOCATED AXES OF STEEP MID LVL LAPSE RATES AND MOISTURE. FARTHER W...SCTD TSTMS EXPECTED TO PERSIST OVER SE SD...ERN NEB...NRN KS...NRN AND WRN IA...AND SRN MN THROUGH MIDDAY. ISOLD STORMS IN THESE AREAS MAY YIELD SPORADIC WIND/HAIL NEAR SVR LIMITS. BUT MORE SUBSTANTIAL STORM DEVELOPMENT LIKELY WILL WAIT UNTIL THIS AFTN/EVE AS SFC HEATING BOOSTS SBCAPE TO AOA 2500 J/KG ALONG AND AHEAD OF PROGRESSIVE COLD FRONT...AND ALONG AND S OF DIFFUSE WARM FRONT. THE COLD FRONT WILL ENCOUNTER LARGELY UNDISTURBED WARM SECTOR OVER NRN MO...SE IA...NRN IL...AND FAR SRN WI...WHERE...DESPITE WEAK LOW LVL FLOW...30 KT WSWLY DEEP SHEAR ON SRN FRINGE OF AMPLIFYING UPR TROUGH COULD SUPPORT CLUSTERS OF SUSTAINED STORMS INCLUDING MULTICELL CLUSTERS AND POSSIBLY A FEW WEAK SUPERCELLS. THESE WILL BE CAPABLE OF SVR WIND AND MARGINALLY SVR HAIL. ONE OR TWO LARGER CLUSTERS MAY ARISE FROM THIS ACTIVITY BY EARLY EVE...EXPANDING THE SVR THREAT INTO PARTS OF CNTRL MI...CNTRL IL...SRN LWR MI...AND NRN/WRN I

sections.title: CNTRL/SRN PLNS THIS AFTN THROUGH TNGT
sections.text: WEAKENED LOW LVL SLY FLOW OVER THE SRN AND CNTRL PLNS OCCURRING IN RESPONSE TO T.S. LEE WILL DIMINISH CONVERGENCE ALONG PLNS PORTION OF COLD FRONT TODAY. NEVERTHELESS...PROGRESSIVE NATURE OF THE FRONT...AND ITS STRENGTH...SUGGEST THAT SCTD TSTMS WILL FORM ALONG THE BOUNDARY LATER TODAY. THERMODYNAMIC SETUP WILL FEATURE STEEP LOW TO MID LVL LAPSE RATES AND FAIRLY SUBSTANTIAL MOISTURE SPREADING SWWD BEHIND THE FRONT...WHILE THE MEAN WIND FIELD REMAINS WEAK. THIS SETUP MAY YIELD A FEW CLUSTERS/SHORT BANDS OF STORMS WITH SPORADIC DMGG WIND/SVR HAIL...MAINLY LATE THIS AFTN/EARLY TNGT FROM PARTS OF KS SWWD INTO NW OK AND THE TX PANHANDLE.

sections.title: CNTRL GULF CST REGION TODAY THROUGH EARLY SUN
sections.text: SATELLITE SHOWS THAT A TONGUE OF RELATIVELY DRY MID LVL AIR HAS BEEN DRAWN EWD INTO S SIDE OF HYBRID T.S LEE. CONTINUED NEWD MOTION OF THIS AIR STREAM MAY ALLOW FOR POCKETS OF ENHANCED LOW LVL DESTABILIZATION WITHIN PLUME OF RICH LOW LVL MOISTURE SPREADING N/NNW ACROSS SE LA...SRN MS....AND SRN AL. GIVEN EXPECTED SLIGHT INCREASE IN LOW LVL WIND FIELD ACROSS REGION /PER NHC FCST/...AND STRONG LOW LVL VEERING PROFILES ALREADY IN PLACE...SETUP MAY BECOME INCREASINGLY FAVORABLE FOR SCTD SHALLOW SUPERCELLS POSING A THREAT FOR TORNADOES. THIS THREAT SHOULD GRADUALLY EXPAND INLAND THROUGH EARLY SUN AS BUOYANCY INCREASES WITH CONTINUED LOW LVL MOISTURE INFLOW.

sections.title: NRN/CNTRL APPALACHIANS THIS AFTN
sections.text: WDLY SCTD TSTMS EXPECTED THIS AFTN OVER PARTS OF NY AND PA. THE STORMS SHOULD BE MOST CONCENTRATED OVER THE HIGHER TERRAIN S OF WEAKENING COLD FRONT...AND NEAR SHALLOW BACKDOOR STNRY FRONT FROM ERN NY/PA SW INTO PARTS OF MD/WV/VA. COMBINATION OF FAIRLY RICH MOISTURE WITH STRONG SFC HEATING SHOULD YIELD POCKETS OF SBCAPE TO 2000 J/KG. COUPLED WITH WEAK MEAN FLOW AND LIMITED FORCING FOR ASCENT...POTENTIAL WILL EXIST FOR PULSE STORMS WITH LOCALLY DMGG WIND AND POSSIBLY SVR HAIL. ..CORFIDI/GARNER.. 09/03/2011

sections.title: MIDWEST/CNTRL GRTLKS REGION
sections.text: WATER VAPOR IMAGERY SHOWS TWO FEATURES OF INTEREST...A SYNOPTIC AND AMPLIFYING POSITIVE-TILT WAVE MOVING THROUGH MN AND A SUBTROPICAL DISTURBANCE ROTATING EWD THROUGH ERN NEB. LATTER FEATURE WILL PROGRESS EWD TOWARD IA/NRN IL THROUGH THIS EVE WITH THE PRIMARY WAVE MOVING INTO THE UPR GRTLKS REGION. IN THE LWR-LVLS...A COMPLEX ARRAY OF BOUNDARIES EXISTS FROM CNTRL LWR MI SWWD INTO SRN IA. SYNOPTIC COLD FRONT...TIED TO THE MAIN UPR TROUGH...WAS BEGINNING TO ACCELERATE SEWD THROUGH CNTRL MN AND NWRN IA...TRAILING TO A WEAK LOW JUST W OF OMAHA. PRIMARY CORRIDOR OF ROBUST HEATING WILL OCCUR ALONG/S OF OUTFLOW BOUNDARIES FROM CNTRL/SRN LWR MI WSW THROUGH NRN IL AND EXTREME SERN IA/NRN MO. HERE...MID-UPR 60S SFC DEW POINTS WILL COMBINE WITH 12Z OBSERVED MID-LVL LAPSE RATES OF 7-7.5 DEG C PER KM FOR MLCAPES 2000-2500 J/KG. COMPARATIVELY WEAKER DESTABILIZATION WILL OCCUR FARTHER N...AHEAD OF THE PRIMARY COLD FRONT...BUT... COOLER MID-LVL TEMPERATURES ASSOCIATED WITH THE PRIMARY TROUGH WILL COMPENSATE SOMEWHAT...ESPECIALLY IN AREAS WHERE CLOUDS THIN SUFFICIENTLY. SCATTERED TSTMS WILL LIKELY FESTER N OF THE OUTFLOW BOUNDARIES AND E OF THE COLD FRONT OVER PARTS OF NRN IA...SE MN AND MUCH OF WI

sections.title: CNTRL GULF COASTAL REGION
sections.text: TS LEE...CENTER VERY CLOSE TO SCNTRL LA...WILL DRIFT SLOWLY N OR NE THIS AFTN/TONIGHT. MARITIME TROPICAL LOW-LEVEL BOUNDARY LAYER WILL EDGE AS FAR NWD AS SRN PARTS OF MS/AL WHILE DRY MID-LVL AIR WRAPS INTO THE SYSTEM FROM THE W/SW. THIS WILL RESULT IN PERIODIC HEATING BETWEEN SPIRAL BANDS AND BOOST THERMAL BUOYANCY AND THREATS FOR BRIEF SHALLOW SUPERCELLS...PARTICULARLY OVER SERN LA AND ADJACENT COASTAL MS THIS AFTN. ABUNDANT LLVL SHEAR WILL BE FAVORABLE FOR A FEW TORNADOES WITHIN THE NE QUAD OF THE HYBRID SYSTEM. THREAT WILL SPREAD FARTHER INLAND OVERNIGHT AS INFLUX OF THE TROPICAL ENVIRONMENT CONTINUES SLIGHTLY NWD AMIDST STRONG 0-1KM SRH.

sections.title: CNTRL/SRN PLAINS
sections.text: COLD FRONT THAT WILL SURGE SEWD INTO SRN KS/NRN OK AND THE SRN HIGH PLAINS WILL BE FOCUS FOR SCATTERED TSTMS THROUGH TONIGHT. THERMODYNAMIC SETUP...FEATURING STEEP LOW/MID-LVL LAPSE RATES AND MODEST LLVL MOISTURE WILL BE CONDUCIVE FOR MULTICELL CLUSTERS/BANDS OF STORMS WITH ISOLD DMGG WINDS/HAIL FROM THE MOUNTAINS OF SRN CO/NM INTO THE TX PNHDL...NRN OK AND SRN KS LATE THIS AFTN/EVE.

sections.title: APLCN MOUNTAIN REGION
sections.text: A FEW TSTMS CAN BE EXPECTED THROUGH EARLY EVENING ALONG THE APLCN CREST AND ADJACENT FOOTHILLS. STORMS WILL CONCENTRATE NEAR SHALLOW BACKDOOR FRONT...ESPECIALLY FROM CNTRL VA SWWD TOWARD THE NC BORDER AHEAD OF A WEAK SWD MOVING MCV. COMBINATION OF FAIRLY RICH MOISTURE WITH STRONG SFC HEATING SHOULD YIELD POCKETS OF SBCAPE TO 2000 J/KG. COUPLED WITH WEAK MEAN FLOW AND LIMITED FORCING FOR ASCENT...POTENTIAL WILL EXIST FOR PULSE STORMS WITH LOCALLY DMGG WIND AND POSSIBLY SVR HAIL. ..RACY/LEITMAN.. 09/03/2011

sections.title: SRN UPPER GREAT LAKES/MIDWEST
sections.text: FAIRLY WIDESPREAD SHOWERS AND THUNDERSTORMS CONTINUE FROM THE UPPER GREAT LAKES REGION SWWD INTO KS -- BOTH ALONG THE SURFACE FRONT CROSSING THE UPPER MS AND MID MO VALLEYS...AND IN THE WARM SECTOR ACROSS IA/IL AND VICINITY INVOF REMNANT CONVECTIVE OUTFLOW. WITH 65 KT MID-LEVEL JET SHIFTING SEWD ACROSS THIS REGION...SHEAR WILL CONTINUE TO SUPPORT ROTATING STORMS GIVEN DEGREE OF ONGOING DESTABILIZATION. WHILE FORECAST FOR LOCALLY DAMAGING WINDS AND HAIL APPEARS ON TRACK...HAVE EXPANDED THE RISK AREA A BIT NWD INTO CENTRAL WI WHERE SOMEWHAT STRONGER DESTABILIZATION IS ONGOING AHEAD OF THE MAIN SURFACE FRONT THAN WAS PREVIOUSLY ANTICIPATED.

sections.title: CENTRAL GULF COAST
sections.text: FORECAST ACROSS THIS AREA REMAINS ON TRACK...WITH T.S. LEE FORECAST TO SHIFT ONLY SLIGHTLY NWD ACROSS SRN LA THE REMAINDER OF THE PERIOD. THIS WILL KEEP THE MOST FAVORABLE NERN QUADRANT OF THE STORM -- WHERE LOW-LEVEL VEERING/SHEAR IS MOST FAVORABLE -- FROM SERN LA EWD TO THE FL PANHANDLE. THUS...WILL MAINTAIN ONGOING PROBABILITIES FOR TORNADO RISK ACROSS THIS REGION -- AS SMALL/TRANSIENT SUPERCELL STORMS EVOLVE WITHIN BANDING NE OF THE CENTER OF LEE. ..GOSS.. 09/03/2011 .PREV DISCUSSION... /ISSUED 1123 AM CDT SAT SEP 03 2011/
